verdict.rationale: Firecrawl supports natural-language-driven agentic search ('describe what you need, no URLs required'), an AI-agent search mode with reasoning control, and MCP/CLI integrations letting AI agents invoke it via natural language through coding assistants. However, most of its own interface is still API/SDK/CLI-parameter driven rather than a native NL command interface, so agenticness is achieved mainly via third-party AI tools/MCP rather than built-in NL control.
